author: RexRegulus
body:
This is one of the few encounters in the entire game that can be fun and challenging due to the fact that they can and will revive each other. The alternative is a random, berserk Immortal Lord or some other ridiculous thing with inflated stats insta-killing you.

Cherish the moment; Things are much less interesting when it all becomes 1-turn, kill-or-be-killed scenarios (the current endgame, more or less).

author: goshe7
body:
Towers were at one point considered end-game content.  You are going in with the wrong expectation that you will clear every mob, every time.  (For what it's worth, that's true even at lvl 250 with several AL as the occasional bezerk boss and associated mobs will land several unblocked attacks on their turn).

In Tier 9, a lot of tower strategy is simply avoiding some mobs.  If that is the only boss, that means you exit the tower before reaching the top floor.  Not exactly what you would hope for on entering a tower, but that's how the cookie crumbles.

author: ExcitingTurn6381
body:
Not a fan of this nonsense at all. One of my characters is basically kicked out of towers until this event is over since every tower has at least one floor blocked off by one of the Sumner groups. These are badly overtuned enemies, and since they are event mobs, they spawn way too often

It’s great for my overpowered BeoH, but for my weaker characters, yeah, they don’t get to do towers anymore until this event is over.
